reviewer: Independent original-pixel, actual-reference and source reviewer

entries.alt: Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon look toward the risen Savior in a vision above their scriptural work.
entries.caption: Joseph and Sidney look up from their work as the vision opens before them. Their testimony reaches beyond the room: they have seen the living Son of God.
entries.findings: Actual canonical Christ, owner-approved Joseph portrait and Sidney historical photograph inspected. Joseph retains nose, chin, brow and light-haired clean-shaven identity at plausible young-adult 26. Sidney is distinct with historical long face, nose and sideburn structure interpreted backward from elderly reference to 38. Christ retains canonical features; v2 lowers gaze toward Joseph instead of above witnesses. Exposed palm has small healed mark and exposed wrist has subtle mark; other hand naturally hidden. Cloud/light boundary clearly portrays vision, not visitor standing on room floor; Father outside frame. Real skin, clothing, manuscript and wood textures.
conditions: Exact heavenly staging, room arrangement and Sidney's reconstructed youthful pigmentation are artistic interpretation. No Father portrait is supplied; do not claim this crop displays every element of D&C76. Manuscript is a prop, not authenticated legible transcript.
Accept v2 only; preserve prior candidate. Technical review is not owner approval or browser verification.
